item.title: Walang pasok: In-person classes suspended Oct. 5 for Nat’l Teachers’ Day
item.dc:creator: mmercado
item.description: Face-to-face classes are suspended in several areas on Monday, October 5, for the celebration of National Teachers’ Day.

item.title: WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions on Thursday, Sept. 10
item.dc:creator: Isabelle Pechay
item.description: Face-to-face classes are suspended in parts of Luzon on Thursday, September 10, amid heavy rains brought by the persistence of the southwest monsoon.
